columns.comment: Collateral item id (COL-nnnnnn).

columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Snapshot date the valuation age and flags are measured at (30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: as_of_date

columns.comment: Collateral type: Cash, Receivables, Inventory, Fixed Assets or Real Estate.
columns.name: collateral_type

columns.comment: Appraised (market) value of the collateral at the last valuation, USD.
columns.name: appraised_value_usd

columns.name: ltv_pct

columns.name: needs_collateral_review

columns.comment: Type of the secured facility (e.g. Term Loan, Revolving Credit Facility).
columns.name: facility_type

columns.comment: Status of the secured facility: Active, Matured or Prepaid.

columns.comment: True when the secured facility is active at the as-of date.
columns.name: is_facility_active

columns.comment: Security type recorded on the facility terms (Cash, Receivables, Inventory, Fixed Assets, Real Estate).

columns.comment: Committed limit of the secured facility, USD (repeats per collateral item; do not sum across items of one facility).
columns.name: facility_limit_usd

comment: Collateral held against credit facilities (credit memo pack, brief 5.3): one row per collateral item with type, appraised value (USD), loan-to-value, last valuation date and its age at 30-Sep-2026, and the review flags LTV above 70% and valuation older than 24 months (dim_threshold LTV_HIGH / VALUATION_STALE_MONTHS), plus the secured facility's type, status, limit and current drawn balance. Current snapshot (valuations as last recorded). Grain: one row per collateral item.
